responsibility: Declares the small public interface for GCC CFG graph dumping: create or append per-function DOT output and bracket a graph dump file with opening and closing graph syntax. It is the API boundary for clients that want graphical control-flow dumps, distinct from graph.cc’s rendering details and graphds.*’s general-purpose graph data structures and algorithms.
same_name_distinction: This is the minimal public header for the graph group: it declares the entry points for starting, appending to, and finishing CFG DOT dumps. Unlike graph.cc, which performs the actual CFG rendering and file emission, this header is only the client-facing API surface.
